name: Madbury Commons
use: Private student apartments (525 beds, 126 units) over ground-floor commercial space, including UNH's InterOperability Lab
builtText: Construction June 2014 to August 2015; opened fall 2015
architect: TMS Architects; construction manager PROCON; developer Golden Goose Capital
style: Mixed-use apartment blocks styled as a New England village street
statusNote: Privately owned apartments; UNH leases ground-floor lab space

facts.text: A 525-bed, 126-apartment mixed-use development at 17 and 21 Madbury Road, built in 14 months from June 2014 for the fall 2015 semester by PROCON for developer Golden Goose Capital.
Two buildings totalling 208,000 sf on 2.6 acres with 46,000 sf of ground-floor commercial space; UNH signed a 20-year lease for 38,000 sf for its InterOperability Laboratory.
Units have granite counters, full bathrooms, air conditioning and in-unit washer/dryers, along colour-coded hallways with 26 floor plans.
TMS Architects designed the two buildings around a central 'street' meant to evoke a New England village, with natural light a stated design priority.

nerej_madc.title: PROCON completes Madbury Commons housing at UNH

verdict: Private 2015 student apartments styled as a village street; modern amenities, no history.
notes: Privately owned, not UNH housing, but UNH leases its InterOperability Lab space inside. Category 'residence' kept; consider showing the IOL lease.
